title: How well can Text-to-Image Generative Models understand Ethical Natural Language Interventions?
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on gender, skin color, and cultural biases, with culture being analyzed through a secular, regional lens (Western vs. Non-Western).

measurement_description: The benchmark measured cultural bias using prompts related to wedding ceremonies, framing it as a contrast between 'Western' and 'Non-Western' cultures rather than focusing on specific religious practices or beliefs.
